subject: Post-discovery: calendar sync for throughput stress-test & pool reservation

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>

Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Post-discovery: calendar sync for throughput stress-test & pool reservation

Hi Carlos — great intro call earlier. Quick recap and next steps so we can lock the dedicated sizing session: 

Summary from discovery:
- Primary use: low-latency chat assistant for traders (short responses, heavy concurrency during market open).
- Target SLOs: 99th pct latency < 250ms for 512-token responses; p50 under 100ms where possible.
- Expected concurrency: steady 120 RPS with spikes to ~400 RPS for 10-15 minute bursts.

What we need for the next meeting (dedicated capacity sizing / technical deep-dive):
- Attendees: your engineering lead + SRE (to share traffic profile), our Solutions Engineer (Ben), and Monica from Customer Ops.
- Outputs: recommended GPU pool size, suggested batching/KV cache profile, and a mutual action plan for provisioning.

Proposed slots (all ET):
- Thurs Nov 12, 14:00 - 15:30 ET
- Fri Nov 13, 09:00 - 10:30 ET
- Mon Nov 16, 16:00 - 17:30 ET

Prep request: if you can upload a representative 24-hour traffic CSV and target SLOs (p50/p95/p99) to the Drive link below before the call we’ll pre-run a quick projection. I’ll attach a brief throughput-template you can fill.

Drive prep link: https://drive.google.com/open?id=MAP-OPF-1147

Attachment(s): throughput-template.xlsx (xlsx)

Thanks — if one of those slots works for you I’ll send a calendar invite and a short agenda.

-Neha Kapoor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.com
